OpusClip alternatives

OpusClip: Finds the best moments in a long video and cuts them into vertical shorts. If it isn't quite right, here are 14 other AI video tools from Radar, in Radar's order.

  1. 1RunwayVideo generation and editing tools for filmmakers, from text, images or footage.Free plan
  2. 2Veo · FlowGoogle's Veo video model in a filmmaking tool, with sound generated alongside.Free plan
  3. 3SoraOpenAI's video model, with sound, and an app for remixing each other's clips.Free plan
  4. 4KlingKuaishou's video generator, strong on realistic motion.Free plan
  5. 5HeyGenTalking-avatar videos, and translating your own videos with your voice.Free plan
  6. 6DescriptEdit video and podcasts by editing the transcript, like a document.Free plan
  7. 7Luma Dream MachineVideo from text and images, with camera moves you can direct.Free plan
  8. 8HailuoMiniMax's video generator, known for lively, physical motion.Free plan
  9. 9PikaPlayful, quick video effects and generations, made for social clips.Free plan
  10. 10HiggsfieldCinematic camera moves and the newest video models in one place.Free plan
  11. 11SynthesiaTraining and explainer videos presented by AI avatars, in 140+ languages.Free plan
  12. 12CapCutA popular video editor with auto-captions, effects and AI editing tools.Free plan
  13. 13InVideoWhole videos, script, footage, voice-over, from a single prompt.Free plan
  14. 14PictoryTurns articles and scripts into short branded videos.Paid

Free to start: Runway, Veo · Flow, Sora.
